scores.visual_critic_note: Clean card grid with a deliberate Tol palette, but the screenshot captures half the cells blank due to staggered animation starts — the gallery looks incomplete at first render.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Animation-focused morphing demo with honest zero baselines and correct area-scale math in data-encoding panels, but all scale domains are hardcoded magic numbers rather than data-derived, and no key functions are used on data joins.
scores.stress_test_note: No user interaction handlers exist (no brush, zoom, drag, mouse, or touch events), so all five stress-test criteria are structurally inapplicable; transitions are strictly sequential via chained callbacks, eliminating mid-flight race conditions, and the only theoretical gap is the absence of .interrupt() guards before each loopMorph transition, which is harmless given the self-chaining design.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 9-cell gallery with clear labels and restrained per-cell color is well-organized, but 9 simultaneous autonomous looping animations compete for peripheral attention at runtime — unassessable from the static screenshot where 5 cells appear empty due to staggered initialization.

proposer: Inlined the `tweenPts` helper directly into the two `attrTween` calls, removing 5 lines (371 → 366). The interpolation behavior is identical.
